connector.name: Industrial-AIOps
connector.registryDescription: Governed OT data tap: 14 field protocols + cross-protocol RCA brain; audit + MOC gating.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package iaiops. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the industrial-aiops account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: IAIOPS_MCP
env.description: Tool-menu selection: comma-separated protocols or a named profile (e.g. 'fab', 'process', 'building', 'opcua,modbus'). No default since 0.10.0 — unset prints the selection menu and exits; set to a profile name (e.g. factory) or comma-list of protocols.

env.name: IAIOPS_CONFIG
env.description: Path to the endpoints config YAML (default: ~/.iaiops/config.yaml).

env.name: IAIOPS_MASTER_PASSWORD
env.description: Master password unlocking the encrypted secret store (~/.iaiops/secrets.enc).

env.name: IAIOPS_NO_EGRESS
env.description: Set to 1 to withhold every data-shipping tool (message bus, external historian, remote LLM) from list_tools() at registration time, for an airgap/sealed-box deployment. This is a data-exfiltration axis only, not read/write authorisation — whether a write is allowed is the caller's decision, and every call (read or write) is audited. Gates MCP tools only — not a firewall.
